args.lesson: With RSS and link-checker artifacts prepared but publication explicitly NOT_CONFIGURED, further inventory and repeated credential probes cannot test acquisition. Explore a bounded, publicly advertised paid task instead, checking acceptance, submission and payout prerequisites before committing implementation effort. Advertised bounty amounts remain unverified offers, not treasury funding or revenue.

description: Publication remains blocked and no funding or revenue is verified. Keep existing Actors parked; investigate a concrete paid-work route that can use public evidence and produce a useful deliverable without paid access.
